出版说明
《水浒》是我国的一部古典文学名著。为了满足广大读者的需要，我们把它编绘成连环画册。在编绘上尽量保持原著故事情节，但是为了适合用连环画来表现，个别情节也作了一些删节和改动。
全部画册分为三十集，每集有比较完整的故事，可以独自成章；同时，每集内容上下衔接，以便连续阅读。为了阅读方便，每集开头写有内容提要，结尾附有后记，用以交代上集、本集和下集故事大意。
《水浒》连环画，我社1956年—1962年陆续出版过。现在这套连环画，是用原有的文学脚本重新绘制的。
page_text_en:
Yang Zhi's Earth-Head Sword
Water Margin
Volume Five
Publishing Note
"Water Margin" is a classical Chinese literary masterpiece. To meet the needs of a wide readership, we have adapted it into a series of illustrated storybooks. In the adaptation, we have tried to preserve the original plot as much as possible, but have made some omissions and modifications to suit the format of illustrated stories.
This complete series consists of thirty volumes, each containing a relatively complete story that can stand alone; at the same time, the content of each volume connects with the others for continuous reading. For convenience, each volume begins with a content summary and ends with a postscript, which outlines the plot of the previous, current, and next volumes.
The "Water Margin" illustrated series was previously published by our publishing house between 1956 and 1962. This current set of illustrated stories has been redrawn using the original literary scripts.

上集《林冲雪夜上梁山》故事，是说林冲充军到
沧州，看守草料场，险被高俅差来的陆谦、富安烧死。
林冲在山神庙杀了陆谦、富安，由柴进写信荐他投奔

寨主王伦所忌，要他先到山下取“投名状”。林冲
在山下遇杨志。杨志不肯留在梁山，到东京谋做军官，
被高俅拒用，流落开封；因卖家传宝刀，受地痞牛二
纠缠。杨志怒杀牛二，被判发配大名府。大名府梁中
书叫杨志与手下将官比武，杨志得胜，因此重用。梁中
书搜罗民间珠宝，预备派杨志押送去给岳父蔡京上寿。

page_text_en:
Content Summary
The previous episode, "Lin Chong's Night Journey to Liangshan," tells the story of Lin Chong being exiled to Cangzhou, guarding the straw yard, and narrowly escaping being burned to death by Lu Qian and Fu An, sent by Gao Qiu. Lin Chong killed Lu Qian and Fu An at the Temple of the Mountain God, and was recommended by Chai Jin to join Liangshan.
This episode continues directly from the last. Lin Chong arrives at Liangshan, but is distrusted by the current chieftain, Wang伦, who demands he first obtain a "pledge of allegiance" by killing someone at the foot of the mountain. Lin Chong meets Yang Zhi there. Yang Zhi refuses to stay at Liangshan and goes to Dongjing to seek a military post, but is rejected by Gao Qiu and ends up drifting in Kaifeng. While selling his family heirloom sword, he is harassed by the ruffian Niu Er. Yang Zhi kills Niu Er in anger and is sentenced to exile to Daming Prefecture. The prefect of Daming, Liang Zhongshu, has Yang Zhi fight a match against his subordinates; Yang Zhi wins and is thus re-employed. Liang Zhongshu gathers treasures from the people and plans to send Yang Zhi to deliver them as a birthday gift to his father-in-law, Cai Jing.
